title: Lab - Secrets
description: Create and consume a Secret, then prove it is only encoded.
scenario: Create and consume a Secret, then prove it is only encoded. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create
tasks.instructions: Create Secret db-secret with DB_Host=sql01, DB_User=root, DB_Password=password123.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Consume
tasks.instructions: Inject all keys into Pod webapp-pod with envFrom.
tasks.verification: kubectl exec webapp-pod -- env | grep DB_

tasks.title: Task 3 - Decode
tasks.instructions: Read the password back out of the Secret.
tasks.solution: kubectl get secret db-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.DB_Password}' | base64 -d
